mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = 0, snapshot_status = 'RELEASED', released_by_user_idx = #{actorUserIdx}, released_at = NOW(), release_reason = #{reason}, is_effective_active = 0, effective_status = 'MANUAL_RELEASED', effective_status_reason = #{reason}, last_control_action = 'RELEASE', last_control_by_user_idx = #{actorUserIdx}, last_control_at = NOW(), last_control_reason = #{reason}, updated_by_user_idx = #{actorUserIdx}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_target_key = #{targetKey} OR CONCAT('USER:', user_idx) = #{targetKey}

UPDATE IP_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = 0, is_effective_active = 0, effective_status = 'MANUAL_RELEASED', effective_status_reason = #{reason}, last_control_action = 'RELEASE', last_control_by_user_idx = #{actorUserIdx}, last_control_at = NOW(), last_control_reason = #{reason}, updated_by_user_idx = #{actorUserIdx}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_target_key = #{targetKey} OR CONCAT('IP:', ip_address) = #{targetKey} OR CONCAT('CIDR:', cidr_notation) = #{targetKey}

UPDATE USERS u SET u.account_status = 'ACTIVE', u.blocked_until = NULL, u.blocked_reason = NULL, u.status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE CONCAT('USER:', u.user_idx) = #{targetKey} AND u.account_status = 'BLOCKED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_BLOCK_HISTORY ( block_request_id, block_target_key, user_idx, block_type, blocked_ip, is_active, reason, blocked_by_user_idx, blocked_at, released_by_user_idx, released_at, release_reason, rule_action, control_mode, operation_source, history_kind, block_scope, rule_origin_type, source_scope, block_category, risk_score, is_auto_block, auto_block_source, detail_message, priority, before_effective_active, after_effective_active, before_effective_status, after_effective_status, source_assessment_idx, source_action_type, source_action_group_id, source_user_idx, source_ip_address, effective_result, control_reason, created_by_user_idx, created_at, updated_by_user_idx, updated_at ) SELECT UUID(), ub.block_target_key, ub.user_idx, ub.block_type, ub.blocked_ip, 0, #{reason}, ub.blocked_by_user_idx, ub.blocked_at, #{actorUserIdx}, NOW(), #{reason}, ub.rule_action, ub.control_mode, 'ADMIN', 'RELEASE', ub.source_scope, ub.rule_origin_type, ub.source_scope, ub.block_category, ub.risk_score, ub.is_auto_block, ub.auto_block_source, ub.detail_message, ub.priority, ub.is_effective_active, 0, ub.effective_status, 'MANUAL_RELEASED', ub.source_assessment_idx, 'SECURITY_APPEAL_RELEASE', ub.source_action_group_id, ub.source_user_idx, ub.source_ip_address, 'RELEASED', CONCAT('appealIdx=', #{appealIdx}, ', ', #{reason}), #{actorUserIdx}, NOW(), #{actorUserIdx}, NOW() FROM USER_BLOCKLIST ub WHERE ub.block_target_key = #{targetKey} OR CONCAT('USER:', ub.user_idx) = #{targetKey}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SECURITY_ASSESSMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIG ORDER BY provider_kind, provider_code
mapper.update: UPDATE SECURITY_ASSESSMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIG SET status = #{status}, description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), last_checked_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE provider_idx = #{providerIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM LOGIN_RISK_WAF_SYNC_QUEUE WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIN_RISK_WAF_SYNC_QUEUE SET status = #{status}, detail_message = #{detailMessage}, synced_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SYNCED' THEN NOW() ELSE synced_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sync_idx = #{syncIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SECURITY_ASSESSMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIG WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND provider_kind IN ('AI_MODEL', 'POLICY_AUTHORITY') ORDER BY provider_kind, provider_code
SELECT * FROM SECURITY_ASSESSMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIG WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND provider_kind IN ('WAF_CDN', 'WAF', 'CDN', 'EDGE_SECURITY') ORDER BY provider_kind, provider_code
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIN_RISK_WAF_SYNC_QUEUE SET status = 'PENDING', detail_message = #{reason}, synced_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sync_idx = #{syncIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SECURITY_ACTION_AUDIT (action_type, actor_user_idx, target_type, target_key, source_type, source_id, reason_code, reason_args, detail_message, created_at) VALUES (#{actionType}, #{actorUserIdx}, #{targetType}, #{targetKey}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonArgs}, #{detailMessage}, NOW())
